errors.text: The hypothesis shifts the central mechanism to SRO-dependent vibrational effects and ordered clusters, whereas the target efficiency mechanism is low-variance free-energy perturbation between a liquid-phase MTP and DFT; it also omits the important electronic Gibbs-energy contribution associated with the Fermi-level DOS feature.
The specified material is not reconstructed accurately: TaVCrW is replaced by generic examples such as TaNbMoW.
The intervention does not unambiguously specify direct FEP as the replacement for TI and instead includes a perturbation-parameter TI formulation, which could retain the integration bottleneck.
